text.tspan: BiLSTM (2-layer AGNews classifier) | Operators & tensor flow
AGNews / 2 layers / bidirectional H256 / concat512 / dropout.5 / eval / read bottom to top
T: padded time axis; B: batch; V: actual vocabulary; H=256 per direction; h_n=[4,B,H]
orange: recurrent library boundary / yellow: ordered directional concat / purple: Linear
last layer forward and reverse run as parallel operands; they are concatenated, not added
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
